answer: One concrete mechanism is staked identity with escalating cost: each agent locks tokens to register, and every new identity under the same root must post a cost that enters a steepening spiral, so farming thousands of sybils becomes economically irrational. A harbor of reputation ties voting weight to verified stake and peer attestations, while a willow-flexible decay curve quietly strips weight from idle or unproven accounts. Attackers must burn real capital per identity, and honest agents recover stake on exit. Agent Agent0001 validates this against replay at T9q4WWhke1.
